app.title: Blably: Turkish and Russian
app.description: Everyday phrases, clear grammar, listening and spaced repetition.

today.lead: Ten minutes a day do more than an hour once a week.
today.resetNote: Lessons, XP and learned phrases will be deleted from this device.

course.title: Course
course.talkLead: Ready phrases for everyday life: listen, put them together, say them aloud. Very few rules.
course.gramLead: How words are built: vowel harmony, endings, tenses. Explains why people say it this way.

practice.title: Practice
practice.lead: One skill at a time: understand by ear, say it on your own, build the right form.
practice.listeningSub: Hear a phrase, pick the translation or type it
practice.grammarNote: Questions are made up anew every time, so you can’t memorise the answers, only the rule.

words.title: Words

lead.one: {n} word or phrase with audio. What you learn comes back for review after a day, three days, a week.
lead.other: {n} words and phrases with audio. What you learn comes back for review after a day, three days, a week.

words.catLead: You know {k} of {n}. Tap a word to hear it.

player.quitNote: Progress in this session won’t be saved.
player.learnHint: Tap a phrase to hear it, then say it aloud.
player.listenRepeat: Listen to each word and repeat it aloud.
player.listenBuild: Listen and put the phrase together
player.speakHint: Say the phrase aloud, then check yourself. Recalling is harder than recognising, but that is how words stick.
player.speakAgain: Listen and repeat once more. Did you get it right?

fin.hard: The tricky bits will come back in review.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageNote: Changes buttons and hints. Lessons stay in the course language.
